manifest.title_fil: Suporta sa panganganak at agarang pag-aalaga
objectives_fil: Gamitin ang aprubadong birth/referral plan, ihanda ang handover sa kwalipikadong team, at ipaliwanag ang sariling saklaw.
objectives_en: Given a labor/newborn case, describe the BHW's support and the qualified birth/newborn-care team pathway.

sections.takeaway_fil: May buntis na nagtatanong kung saan manganak at sino ang tutulong sa sanggol.
sections.takeaway_en: A pregnant resident asks where to give birth and who will care for the newborn.

sections.takeaway_fil: Gamitin ang aprubadong birth/referral plan, ihanda ang handover sa kwalipikadong team, at ipaliwanag ang sariling saklaw.
sections.takeaway_en: Describe the BHW's support and the qualified birth/newborn-care team pathway.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang pinakamainam na gagawin ng BHW sa sitwasyong ito?
check.prompt_en: What should the BHW do in this situation?

options.fil: Mag-alok na gawin nang mag-isa ang klinikal na hakbang na kailangan ng trained provider.
options.en: Offer to perform a clinical procedure alone that requires a trained provider.

options.fil: Gamitin ang aprubadong birth/referral plan, ihanda ang handover sa kwalipikadong team, at ipaliwanag ang sariling saklaw.
options.en: Describe the BHW's support and the qualified birth/newborn-care team pathway.

options.fil: Ipagpaliban nang walang plano o pag-follow-up.
options.en: Delay without a plan or follow-up.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi ito ligtas o hindi nakumpirma. 2: Ito ang angkop na unang hakbang. 3: Walang malinaw na susunod na hakbang.
check.feedback_en: 1: This is unsafe or unconfirmed. 2: This is the appropriate first step. 3: No next step is arranged.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa kathang-isip na kasong ito, ginamit ni Mira ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay bago sumagot.
sections.takeaway_en: In this fictional case, Mira checks the current local guide before responding.

sections.takeaway_fil: Iwasan ang ganitong kilos: Mag-alok na gawin nang mag-isa ang klinikal na hakbang na kailangan ng trained provider.
sections.takeaway_en: Avoid this action: Offer to perform a clinical procedure alone that requires a trained provider.

sections.takeaway_fil: Piliin ang kilos na may nakikitang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Choose the action with an observable result.

check.prompt_fil: Aling kilos ang nagpapakita ng maayos na pagtupad?
check.prompt_en: Which action shows the task was done well?

options.fil: Ginamit ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay at naipakita ang mahalagang hakbang: Gamitin ang aprubadong birth/referral plan, ihanda ang handover sa kwalipikadong team, at ipaliwanag ang sariling saklaw.
options.en: Avoids representing unsupervised clinical procedures as BHW tasks.

options.fil: Sabihing natapos ang gawain kahit walang naitalang resulta.
options.en: Say the task is complete without recording an outcome.

options.fil: Mag-alok na gawin nang mag-isa ang klinikal na hakbang na kailangan ng trained provider.
options.en: Offer to perform a clinical procedure alone that requires a trained provider.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Ito ang nakikitang patunay ng gawain. 2: Walang naitalang resulta. 3: Hindi ito ang angkop na kilos.
check.feedback_en: 1: This is observable evidence of the task. 2: There is no recorded result. 3: This is not the appropriate action.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa susunod na pinangangasiwaang pagsasanay, gamitin ang kathang-isip na kasong ito.
sections.takeaway_en: At the next supervised practice, use this fictional case.
